draft_metadata.classification_reason: 本论文核心是针对 CYP725A4 (T5αOH) 这一关键 P450 酶的祖先序列重构 (ASR) 与酶工程改造，按用户提供的三框架本应归入'酶工程酶类'，但用户允许路径列表为空 ([])，无对应条目可填，按规则置空。本研究真实学科方向：P450 酶的定向分子改造与萜类天然产物生物合成。
source_gaps: 论文提及 Figure S1 (祖先酶 GC 与质谱)、Figure S2 (野生型与突变体 SDS-PAGE/Western blot)、Table S1 (菌株、质粒与 DNA 序列)，但 SI 未随正文提供，相关原始电泳图、质谱图与序列一致性表无法核实。
蛋白纯化'仍在进行中'，作者未提供 T5αOH 野生型与 V124I/S127A 突变体的体外动力学参数 (K<sub>m</sub>、k<sub>cat</sub>) 或热稳定性数据，活性差异的酶学机制只能停留在推论层级。
同源建模使用 AlphaFold2 预测结构，论文未提供模型质量评估 (如 Ramachandran 分布、pLDDT 分数) 的明确数值，α-helix6 与血红素空间距离的量化数据缺失。

minor_issues.issue: 草稿正文第五节(二)中估算 WT T5αOH '约 3.0 mg/gDCW 总产物、约 0.7 mg/gDCW 主产物' 系根据 Figure 4B 视觉读图，原文仅给出 'more than 3-fold higher than T5αOH'，未明示 WT 比活数值；按图读数 WT 总产物更接近 4–5 mg/gDCW。建议将估算标注为'视觉读图近似值'。

verified_claims.evidence: putative ancestral sequences differ from the T5αOH by 11.9% (A4), 13.3% (A3), 19.8% (A2), and 21.3% (A1)

verified_claims.claim: T5αOH WT 总氧化产物 28.4 ± 6.8 mg/L、taxadien-5α-ol 7.1 ± 1.0 mg/L；A3 总滴度 32.1 ± 2.8 mg/L
verified_claims.evidence: yields of total monooxygenated compounds and taxadien-5α-alcohol were 28.4 ± 6.8 and 7.1 ± 1.0 mg L−1... total oxidation product titer of ancestor A3 was 32.1 ± 2.8 mg L−1

verified_claims.claim: V124I 总/T-5α-ol = 10.6 ± 4.8 / 2.3 ± 1.0 mg gDCW⁻¹；S127A = 12.6 ± 1.6 / 2.8 ± 0.5 mg gDCW⁻¹；二者均较 WT 'more than 3-fold higher'
verified_claims.evidence: yields... increased to 10.6 ± 4.8 and 2.3 ± 1.0 mg gDCW−1 (V124I), and 12.6 ± 1.6 and 2.8 ± 0.5 mg gDCW−1 (S127A); more than 3-fold higher than those of T5αOH

verified_claims.claim: V124I–S127A 双突变比活进一步提升至 14.4 ± 1.7 (总) 和 2.8 ± 0.3 mg gDCW⁻¹ (T-5α-ol)
verified_claims.evidence: double-point mutant T5αOH (V124I−S127A) further increased to 14.4 ± 1.7 and 2.8 ± 0.3 mg gDCW−1, respectively

verified_claims.claim: 3-L 发酵 48 h 总单氧化产物 110.3 mg/L、taxadien-5α-ol 22.5 mg/L、时空产率 55.2 mg L⁻¹ day⁻¹
verified_claims.source_locator: 物理页 5，3.2 节末段与 Figure 5
verified_claims.evidence: After 48 h of fermentation, the titer of total monooxygenated products was 110.3 mg L−1 (space-time yield, 55.2 mg L−1 day−1), of which taxadien-5α-ol was 22.5 mg L−1

verified_claims.claim: α-helix6 (残基 118–132) 包含 15 个氨基酸，7 个差异位点，被定为突变热点，靠近血红素
verified_claims.source_locator: 物理页 5，3.2 节正文与图 4A
verified_claims.evidence: α-helix6 (amino acids 118−132); this mutation 'hotspot' contains 15 amino acids, of which 7 are different... Homology modeling indicates that this α-helix is located near the cofactor heme ring

verified_claims.claim: ASR 共采用 22 条序列（21 条 CYP725A 亚家族 + CYP716B 外群 Ginkgo biloba T9αOH）
verified_claims.evidence: for a total of 21 sequences. Additionally, T9αOH from Ginkgo biloba, which belongs to the CYP716B subfamily... In total, 22 sequences were obtained
